$comment: Act bosses. One closes every sector (an act is a sector), themed by the level type. `bossForLevel` in src/systems/boss.ts is the only reader: rows that list the level type — or the `any` wildcard — and that have unlocked by the act are eligible, and the highest `minAct` wins with a tie going to table order. `variantEvery` fields a row every Nth act from its `minAct`, so the wildcard gunship is the act 2+ variant (acts 2, 4, 6) rather than a replacement for the type's own machine; it also carries a type with no machine of its own (canyon). Attack pattern ids are implemented in src/systems/boss.ts; adding a boss here needs no class. Asset ids are derived as `boss/<id>`, which matches the art-07-boss cell slugs.
